verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a native natural-language interface is a community report that GA4 offers 'insights' where you describe your query in plain text. The same user reports it always gets it wrong, and no vendor documentation describes the feature. The official MCP server is a separate agent-integration capability whose natural-language handling comes from an external AI client, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of natural-language querying or commands, evidence it works reliably, natural-language operation beyond reporting queries (e.g., configuration), and independent positive corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
